messages:
Vera: quick follow-up from the AttrV2 RFC. we still need a deterministic join pattern for cost attribution when cost_key is added by late enrichment and we sample at edge.
Hector: problem statement: sampled envelopes lose cost_key if enrichment happens after sampling. options: require ingress cost_key, move sampling downstream, or introduce a joinable claim.
Yasmin: propose using a compact, compacted kafka topic named `cost-claims` keyed by trace_id. enrichment writes a single claim record (trace_id -> cost_key, src=service, ts). compacted topic ensures latest wins and is cheap to retain. billing lookup will consult topic via a fast local cache.
Omar: compacted topic is nice but needs a low-latency lookup. suggestion: use a small LRU read-through cache (per-billing-shard) filled from `cost-claims` changelog; claims carry a visible watermark header `attr-schema:2` so downstream knows which schema produced the claim.
Vera: also add `claim_ttl_days=7` and record `cost_claim_status` in core: ingress,enrichment,late,missing. if a claim arrives after billing window mark late and enqueue backfill job.
Hector: we should not promote arbitrary extension keys into columns without governance. sidecar catalog idea stands: weekly promoter service picks hot keys, emits slot ids. new header `attr-schema-version` lets ingest route validate which format clients used.
Yasmin: rollout plan: 1) implement `cost-claims` topic + small cache prototype (Omar) 2) dual-write v1+v2 at 3% for 2w 3) monitor billing_match_rate, claim_latency_p95, extension_blob_delta 4) expand to 25% then 100% with per-org opt-out. set alert: billing_match_rate drop >0.5%.
Omar: owners: Vera = final CORE list + rollout doc, Hector = sidecar catalog + promotion heuristics, Yasmin = cost-claims topic + cache prototype, Omar = ingest validation + schema header checks. i'll open follow-up ticket and link infra tasks.
ingest-bot: created follow-up ticket ORG-10111 "AttrV2: cost-claims kafka prototype + watermarking" assigned to Vera, Hector, Yasmin, Omar. :white_check_mark:
Vera: thanks all, i'll post the addendum RFC link once it's up.
